ROOT.scriptdef: SET NOCOUNT ON; IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'CDN.Sent') AND name = 'SnT_WojewodztwoT') AND EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'CDN.Sent') AND name = 'SnT_DlugoscGeoT') AND EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'CDN.Sent') AND name = 'SnT_SzerokoscGeoT') BEGIN DECLARE @sql VARCHAR(150) SET @sql = 'UPDATE CDN.Sent SET SnT_Wojewodztwo = SnT_WojewodztwoT,SnT_DlugoscGeo = SnT_DlugoscGeoT,SnT_SzerokoscGeo = SnT_SzerokoscGeoT' EXECUTE(@sql) SET @sql = 'ALTER TABLE CDN.Sent DROP COLUMN SnT_WojewodztwoT,SnT_DlugoscGeoT,SnT_SzerokoscGeoT' EXECUTE(@sql) END SET NOCOUNT OFF;
